reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend helper and routes every weekend check through a new shared isNonWorkingDay predicate instead of reimplementing the move logic.

duplication.why: The holiday rule itself is defined once, but the look-ahead padding heuristic (holidays.length added to take/margin) is repeated with different formulas at three sites.

placement.why: The predicate and date-moving logic live in shared/schedules.ts next to the existing weekend helper, and callers only pass the new field through.

scope.why: Touches only the type, the shared helper, the call sites that apply weekend handling, and a release note.

maintainability.why: Clean single definition of a non-working day, though the ad-hoc per-site occurrence padding tied to holidays.length is fragile and repeated.

one_place.where: isNonWorkingDay and getDateWithSkippedWeekend in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template
